MAJOR difference in listed and actual faction. Three kills of Brother Nallin took Guards of Qeynos from Amiably to Dubiously, indicating the negative hit to Guards of Qeynos is at least -167.

Jan 18, 2014 patch: "Brother Nallin of North Karana will now cure poison and disease upon request and components. (Indifferent or better faction)"


If you are worse than Indifferent:

You say, 'Hail, Brother Nallin'
Brother Nallin says 'Your mere presence disgusts me. Please remove yourself from my sight.
 Until you change yourself and your ways, you are unwelcome in the Temple of Life.'
 
Indifferent faction or better...

You say, 'Hail, Brother Nallin'

Brother Nallin says 'May the Prime Healer watch over your body as you pass through these dangerous lands.
 I am Brother Nallin of the [Temple of Life]. I was dispatched to aid the guards and residents of the plains.
 I can assist you if you have need of me to [cure poison] or [cure disease].'

You Say, "can you cure poison"
 Brother Nallin says, 'If you would like me to cure poison, you must offer me four water flasks.
 I shall see that the residents of the plains get your donation and we shall try to cast the toxin from your body.'

Give Brother Nallin 4 Single [[Water Flask]] unstacked,
 Brother Nallin says 'May Rodcet Nife breathe upon your body and soul and banish the evil from within.'
Brother Nallin begins to cast a spell. 

You Say, "can you cure disease,
 Brother Nallin says 'Yes, I can cast the disease from your body with the power of the Prime Healer.
 First, you must make an offering to the Temple of Life. The offering is five gold coins.'

Give Brother Nallin 5 gold,
Brother Nallin says 'May Rodcet Nife breathe upon your body and soul and banish the evil from within.'
Brother Nallin begins to cast a spell.

"there are no faction changes for either quest turn-in"
